# Asien Special Tours — US English

> Asien Special Tours is a Travel Atelier designing tailor-made, privately guided journeys in Asia, with personal advice from Travel Atelier Advisors, selected accommodations, and a dedicated chauffeur and guide.

## Current focus and important limits
- Israel Private Collection: https://www.asien-special-tours.de/en-us/israel-luxusreisen/
- Israel's sample 13-day itinerary is inspiration, not a booking or feasibility guarantee. Confirm the current security situation, government travel advisories, access, opening hours, holiday schedules, and availability before planning. Hotel imagery does not establish a hotel partnership.
- Israel inquiry budgets are per person, excluding international flights. EUR and USD are separate planning budgets, not currency conversions.
- General Asia inquiry planning normally starts at €5,000 per person, including international flights. Lower-budget inquiries are directed to Europa Special Tours without transferring personal contact details.
- AST Connector+ is a mobile app in beta/pre-production. Not all integrations are in production; some are simulated or use placeholder data. There is currently no public app store download. Features must be confirmed for each journey.

Travel ideas are inspiration, not binding package offers. Itineraries and services are agreed individually. Inquiry forms prepare email drafts; they do not automatically book a trip or send an inquiry through this website. The contact page's privacy information remains a pre-launch placeholder, not a final legal policy.

This file supports discoverability but is not a standardized substitute for the website or structured data.
